final: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoices AS i JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), total AS (SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_count FROM gender_counts), shares AS (SELECT g.gender, g.invoice_count, 1.0 * g.invoice_count / t.total_count AS share FROM gender_counts AS g JOIN total AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT s.gender, s.invoice_count, s.share, s.share - a.value FROM shares AS s JOIN average_share AS a ON a.value IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.value
